login.title: Log in
login.intro: Enter your email address. We'll send you a link to log in — no password needed.
login.sentText: We've sent a login link to {email}. Tap the link in that email to log in.
login.sentHint: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder too. You can request a new link after a minute.
login.resendIn: You can send again in {seconds} s

errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.rateLimit: You've just requested a link. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.linkExpired: This login link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.emailLimit: Too many login emails were sent in the last hour. Try again in an hour. If you're already logged in on another device, you can carry on there.

overview.title: Welcome to MenuBuddy
overview.intro: You're logged in. Here's how to get your menu online:

steps.title: Set up your restaurant
steps.text: Name, address, logo and the languages for your guests.

steps.title: Upload your menu
steps.text: A photo or PDF of your menu. AI turns it into dishes.

steps.title: Check and publish
steps.text: Check prices and allergens, then print your QR code.

loadError: Your details couldn't be loaded. Check your internet connection.

setup.title: Set up your restaurant
setup.intro: This takes a minute. You can change everything later.
setup.name: Restaurant name
setup.sourceLanguageHint: The language your menu is printed in now.
setup.guestLanguagesHint: Your menu gets translated into these languages. You can add more later.
setup.webAddressHint: This address goes into your QR code. Choose it carefully: it can't change once printed.
setup.slugChecking: Checking if this address is free…
setup.slugTaken: This address is already taken. Choose another one.
setup.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 60 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (e.g. brasserie-lindehof).

errors.name: Enter your restaurant's name.
errors.languages: Choose at least one language for your guests.
errors.slug: Choose a web address that's free.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Check your internet connection and try again.

allergens.question: Show allergens on your menu?
allergens.hint: You check and confirm the allergens of each dish before guests see them. You can change this any time.

upload.title: Upload your menu
upload.intro: Take a photo of each page of your menu, in order. The AI reads the dishes, prices and descriptions. You check everything before guests see it.
tips: One menu page per photo, the whole page in view
Good light, no glare, hold the phone straight

errors.tooMany: You can upload up to {max} photos at a time.
errors.unsupported: One photo couldn't be opened. Try taking it again with the camera, or choose a JPEG or PNG.
errors.upload: Uploading didn't work. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: You've read a lot of menus today. Try again tomorrow, or contact us.

result.readingText: This usually takes 30 to 90 seconds. You can leave this page: the result will be waiting here.

errors.not_a_menu: These photos don't seem to show a menu. Take a photo of the menu pages and try again.
errors.unreadable: The text was too hard to read. Take sharper photos with good light, one page per photo.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.stale: This took too long and was stopped. Try again.

result.unknownDish: Unknown dish: add a description later

empty.title: Your menu is still empty
empty.text: Upload a photo of your menu and the AI fills it in. Or start with a category yourself.

sheet.title: Edit dish
sheet.name: Name as on your menu
sheet.nameHint: Guests see this name exactly as written; the translation goes underneath.
sheet.descriptionHint: Your own description. It is translated as written.
sheet.typicalHint: Shown in italics to guests when you have no description of your own.
sheet.unknown: Unknown dish: guests see "Ask staff" until you add a description.
sheet.allergensSuggested: Suggested by the AI. Check them, then confirm. Guests only see confirmed allergens.
sheet.allergensConfirmed: Confirmed by you. Guests see these allergens.
sheet.photoEmpty: No photo yet. Tap to add one.
sheet.photoError: The photo couldn't be uploaded. Try another one.

toast.error: Couldn't save. Check your internet connection.

prices.intro: Type the new prices, then tap "Apply changes". Leave a box empty to keep the price.
prices.invalid: Some prices aren't valid. Use for example 12,50.

allergenSwitch.title: Allergens on your menu
allergenSwitch.label: Show allergens to guests
allergenSwitch.offText: Off: guests see no allergen information, only the note "For allergies, please inform staff before ordering." Allergens you confirmed earlier are kept for when you switch this on again.
allergenSwitch.pending: {count} dishes still need your allergen confirmation. Until you confirm them, guests see "Allergen info not confirmed — please ask staff" for those dishes.
allergenSwitch.pendingOne: 1 dish still needs your allergen confirmation. Until you confirm it, guests see "Allergen info not confirmed — please ask staff" for that dish.
allergenSwitch.allConfirmed: On: all dishes are confirmed. New dishes will ask for confirmation.

resultExtra.importText: Replace your current menu with this one, or add these dishes at the end?
resultExtra.doneText: Compare names and prices with your menu, then tap "Use this menu". Afterwards you can correct everything, confirm allergens and add photos.
resultExtra.used: This menu has been added. Open your menu to check it.
